user_input: Which mitigation options have direct, active mitigates relationships in Enterprise ATT&CK 17.1 to the technique mapped to PasswordFox in AA23-165A? Follow the two-hop software-to-technique-to-mitigation path. Distinguish advisory observations from reference recommendations.
response:

Execution Prevention (M1038) mitigates Impair Defenses (T1562). [E8]
